evidence.heading: Medium Artificial Intelligence content policy
evidence.excerpt: Current publication requirements for AI-assisted writing, AI-generated imagery, disclosure, and distribution were checked on 2026-08-28. The series is delivered as drafts requiring substantive human editing and appropriate disclosure.

evidence.heading: Medium Distribution Guidelines
evidence.excerpt: Current quality and distribution guidance was checked on 2026-08-28 to inform the editorial handoff. No distribution outcome is promised.

evidence.heading: Change screen resolution and layout in Windows
evidence.excerpt: Official Microsoft guidance distinguishes display scale from display resolution and supports the alignment article's controlled-baseline framing.

evidence.heading: Deadlock crash report involving a mod conflict
evidence.excerpt: A May 2026 community report on the official Deadlock forum was used only as a symptom example. It is not treated as a universal diagnosis or proof of current product behavior.

evidence.heading: Deadlock update thread dated 2026-06-30
evidence.excerpt: The current official forum confirms that the game continues to change; the drafts therefore avoid freezing patch-dependent behavior into evergreen claims.

evidence.heading: Deadlock rope and zipline behavior report
evidence.excerpt: A current official-forum user report supports treating zipline state and vertical travel as context-sensitive. It is used as a research signal, not a universal mechanics claim.

evidence.heading: CS2 stretched display cursor-offset report after focus change
evidence.excerpt: A July 2026 community report was used only to identify a current symptom pattern for the display-alignment diagnostic. It does not establish cause.

evidence.heading: Archived CS2 visual-readability discussion
evidence.excerpt: A dated archived forum discussion was used only as evidence that users complain about crosshair occlusion and slow fade behavior. No current product fact was taken from it.

evidence.heading: CS2 product mapping and external-memory constraints
evidence.excerpt: Local product memory establishes the required cluster.center mapping and the rule that changing support, price, status, and feature claims must be checked at the official source.

evidence.heading: Deadlock product mapping and internal-memory constraints
evidence.excerpt: Local product memory establishes the required cluster.center mapping and prohibits unsupported current claims or operational anti-cheat guidance.

strict_rules: Use only supported facts or mark uncertainty explicitly.
Treat community reports as symptom signals, not universal diagnoses.
Do not invent current patch, price, ban-wave, anti-cheat, service, support, or product-status facts.
Do not provide operational anti-cheat evasion, installation, or implementation instructions.
Do not weaken normal security settings.
Use the required Medium anchor once per article outside the introduction, FAQ, and conclusion.
Use cluster.center for CS2 and Deadlock.
